title: A Boar in Camp
text: A wild boar charges into camp at night. After a brief scuffle there is meat for a week.

title: The Forester's Trail
text: In the morning someone finds fresh boot prints around the camp. The count's forester knows where you are.

title: A Song about the Band
text: At the crossroads inn they already sing about your band. The men are proud, though it is dangerous.

title: Downpour in the Woods
text: Rain pours all night. The shelters leak and the fire goes out every hour.

title: Peasants with a Basket
text: Peasants from a nearby village bring bread and cheese. They remember who chased off the tax collector.

title: A Quarrel over the Share
text: Two outlaws quarrel over a purse from the last robbery. Knives come out before the chief separates them.

title: A Fugitive from Town
text: A prisoner on the run walks into camp. For a place by the fire they give everything they have.

title: Wolves in the Night
text: The howling of wolves does not stop until dawn. Nobody sleeps and the watch changes every hour.

title: Treasure under a Root
text: Digging a refuse pit, someone hits a rotten box with a few coins in it.

title: A Wanted Poster at the Inn
text: A scout brings back a torn wanted poster. The description of the chief is surprisingly accurate.

title: Taal's Feast
text: The band keeps Taal's feast under an old oak. Tonight the forest seems friendly.

title: A Lost Satchel
text: Someone left a satchel of food by the stream. By morning only fox tracks remain.

title: A Stranger in the Woods
text: The sentry hears someone circling the camp.
okText: The scout comes up behind the intruder. It is only a lost shepherd, but they know where the hunters are camped.

title: A Stag at the Clearing
text: At dawn a stag steps into the clearing. One shot and there will be meat.
okText: The poacher does not miss. The band eats its fill for the first time in a week.

title: Marsh Fever
text: After a night by the marsh several men shake with chills and fever.
okText: The hedge healer brews willow bark and the fever breaks by noon.

title: A Drunken Giant
text: A drunken woodcutter staggers into camp looking for a fight.
okText: The bruiser hoists him over a shoulder and carries him back to the woods. Everyone laughs.
